notes: ref MUST be an immutable commit SHA, not a tag or branch. Tags can be re-pointed.
Bump this file on each release: pin to the SHA of the merge commit that lands the templates.
Consumers (the CLI) read this file at runtime to avoid drift between CLI version and template contents.

checksums.<type> is the SHA-256 of templates/<type>/package.json, the lockfile entry point. The CLI verifies the on-disk package.json against this digest before using the local fast path; on mismatch it falls through to the SHA-pinned degit remote path.
